science_vegetable: Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea

horizon_goals.immediate_session_goal: Understand and map the ferrofluid sea's shifting shear boundaries.
horizon_goals.mid_term_milestone: Harness thermal output to power the hearth's expanding grid.
horizon_goals.campaign_arc_climax: Complete metabolic autonomy against entropic environmental decay.

three_levels_of_why.level_1_immediate: The fluctuating shear is disrupting the hearth's immediate thermal intake.
three_levels_of_why.level_2_local: Ryn needs Silas to recalibrate the containment field to prevent ambient temperature spikes.
three_levels_of_why.level_3_campaign_arc: Mastering the ferrofluid anomalies is necessary to stabilize the colony's central engine.

active_location.macro_silhouette: A sweeping metallic observation bay jutting over a roiling, dark ocean.

sensory_palette.sight_and_color: The inky expanse of the ferrofluid sea fractures into sharp, fractal peaks of silver and violet, dancing along invisible fault lines. Flashes of amber warning lights cut through the steam.
sensory_palette.smell: Ozone masking the metallic tang of vaporized iron, underscored by a sharp, synthetic spice.
sensory_palette.sound: The low, resonant hum of the main engine punctuated by the erratic, deep-bass thrumming of the shifting shear.
sensory_palette.tactile_temperature: The air is stifling and heavy, vibrating with sub-audible frequencies that tingle against the jaw.
sensory_palette.taste_optional: A faint, lingering coppery residue on the tongue from the atmospheric charge.

interactive_features.affordance_description: A heavy blast-shielded terminal covered in condensation, used to buffer the thermal feedback.
An exposed array of copper coils that, if calibrated, can sync with the ferrofluid's frequency.
Sputtering grates releasing thick, blinding vapor that obscures line of sight to the bay doors.

reactive_toys.name_and_role: Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea
reactive_toys.description: A chaotic fluid-dynamic boundary layer expressing itself as a jagged, magnetic wave.
reactive_toys.consistent_method: Generating erratic pressure spikes that test thermal thresholds.
reactive_toys.immediate_complication: The shear threatens to overload the intake buffer before Ryn can relay the specs to Silas.
reactive_toys.uninterrupted_escalation: The shear will rupture the primary coolant line, plunging the deck into scalding vapor.

judge_tactician.failure_stakes_declared: If Ryn fails to buffer the intake, the shear spikes the temperature, causing localized equipment damage and a difficult recovery for Silas.

graduated_outcomes.nat_1_false_intuition: Ryn misreads the wave frequency entirely; the feedback knocks the terminal offline, escalating the hazard.
graduated_outcomes.below_dc_complicated_fail_forward: Ryn buffers the intake just enough to prevent a blowout, but the controls fuse shut—Silas will have to bypass the relay manually.
graduated_outcomes.meets_dc_clean_success: Ryn perfectly syncs the buffer with the shear, stabilizing the flow and smoothly handing off control to Silas.
graduated_outcomes.dc_plus_5_or_20_extended_lore: Ryn isolates a harmonious resonance in the shear, not only stabilizing the flow but revealing a new, highly efficient thermal tapping method.

master_narrator.agency_handoff_prompt: Ryn finishes logging the fluctuating vectors. She firmly claps the datapad onto Silas's chest. 'The shear is throwing spikes at fourteen hertz. It's yours now, Silas. Don't let it cook us.'
